topics.topic: How import_snapshot supplies its single instant as the appended audit record's occurred_at timestamp
questions: The required audit write produces an AuditRecord with occurred_at, but append_audit accepts neither the single instant nor an intent containing a timestamp; must append_audit accept occurred_at, must AuditIntent gain occurred_at, or is the audit timestamp excluded from “every timestamp it writes”?
How can import_snapshot require the audit written by append_audit to use its single instant when append_audit accepts no timestamp argument?

The audit operation writes an AuditRecord with occurred_at, but neither append_audit nor AuditIntent accepts the single instant read by import_snapshot; which passage must change, or how can append_audit be made to use that exact instant?

judgement.why: This asks the same question already resolved by P1, and the relevant signatures and model fields have not changed.

topics.topic: Whether the single-instant rule excludes publication-supplied approved_at and published_at timestamps copied into the snapshot
questions: Must “every timestamp it writes” exclude publication-supplied approved_at and published_at, or must the provenance requirement stop copying those timestamps?

ApprovedEstimateSnapshot content includes publication approved_at and published_at timestamps, which must be copied rather than replaced by the single current instant; must “every timestamp it writes” be narrowed to operation-generated timestamps?

quotes: - _build_approved_snapshot: [PROVENANCE] MUST copy publication identity/content, actor service principal and key_version, fingerprint, and received_at into a new immutable snapshot without Registry name/address fields.

- import_snapshot: [BEHAVIOR] MUST read the current UTC time once per operation, by one call of utc_now, and use that single instant for every timestamp it writes and every current-time comparison it makes; it MUST NOT read a host clock itself.
judgement.why: Copying the publication content requires preserving its approved_at and published_at timestamps, while the single-instant rule requires every timestamp written by the operation to use the captured current instant.
